data.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 1694, merged to main (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). 24 files, +326/-473. Full suite 12,622 passed / 0 failed; lint, typecheck, env-registry and complexity-baseline gates all clean.

SCOPE NARROWED ON EVIDENCE, as recorded in the plan: only the ENV VAR was removed. The config key [tool.rebar.llm].model STAYS — rebar.toml sets it load-bearingly to pin the provider and stop inference leaking to a non-Bedrock default, LLMConfig.model is read widely, and the deprecation registry row was env-only anyway. model now resolves CLI > [tool.rebar.llm].model > DEFAULT_MODEL, with _llm_str taking env_name=None for the no-env-channel case. _deprecated_bare_model() and the fallback_default rung are deleted, so class-slot precedence is CLI > per-class env > config table > built-in default. The per-class REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_MODEL vars and the per-step workflow model: override are untouched.

REGISTRY + TOMBSTONE TREATMENT: the _scheduled env row was DELETED and the pass recorded in rebar._deprecations' historical-record NOTE (the DE7 / ticket-5899 shape). UNLIKE the sibling review-surfaces change, this one IS TOMBSTONED — it is an env input an operator may still have exported, exactly what the tombstone registry (env/cfg/file kinds) exists for. behavior='error', matching the closest precedent _tomb('env','REBAR_LLM_MAX_ITERS',...): silently ignoring a still-set model id would quietly change which model every operation runs, i.e. cost and quality, with no signal. The check is wired in LLMConfig.from_env alongside MAX_ITERS so a retired LLM knob fails loud only when the LLM stack actually loads, and RemovedInputError is a BaseException so the broad except Exception on the tracker-probe path cannot demote it to a silent default.

tests/unit/test_llm_model_env_deprecation.py was renamed to test_llm_model_env_removal.py and rewritten as a 9-test tombstone suite; 6 other test files were retargeted off the removed env channel onto surviving rungs (a CLI-override helper, the config table, or the env-backed model_provider sibling). Docs regenerated for env-vars.md; 7 hand-written docs plus infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md and infra/compose/docker-compose.yml reworded from 'deprecated' to 'removed'.
